about: Techno feel: a machine-straight kick, the rumble on the kick's own tick, the acid line tight on the grid (its accents and normal notes play as written) with only its ghosts swung (2-7 ticks) and drifting, the snare's ghosts on the kit's swing (10) and its clap layer 2-5 ticks behind it, hats swung a little more (12-14, 13-16 in the second drop), the anvil perc a deep shuffle (21-24), the drone nearly straight, the lead blips on the kit's swing or a touch past it (10-12). The acid, hats and perc sit in tiers at least 5 ticks apart, so the drift never merges their swings. Swing ranges are permille relative to the kit's swing; sd values are tenths of a tick (1/f), vsd tenths of a velocity step.
